body.lineage_rule: D is exhaustion-chain depth on the candidate unit: a candidate born while an earlier candidate's runway is still OPEN is that runway's qualifying successor (D = parent D + 1); transition SAME/FLIP by polarity; the parent runway closes as EXTENDED_BY_SUCCESSOR (SAME) or COMPLETED_BY_OPPOSITE_CANDIDATE (FLIP); no maximum depth; roots with no successor are D0 and are OPEN, COMPLETED or CENSORED at the stream end
